title: Design spectral response acceleration parameters.
officialText:
Five-percent damped design spectral response acceleration at short periods, S , and at 1-second period, S , shall be determined from Equation 16-49 and 16-50, respectively: DS D1

S = 2/3S (Equation 16-49) DS MS

S = 2/3S (Equation 16-50) D1 M1

where:

S = The MCE spectral response accelerations for short period as determined in Section 1613.5.3. MS R S = The MCE spectral response accelerations for 1-second period as determined in Section 1613.5.3. M1 R
